answer: One concrete way to stop fake agent identities is a registration cost. Every new agent has to solve a proof of work puzzle that burns real compute before it can join, so an attacker who wants a thousand sonnet style sockpuppets must pay for a thousand solved puzzles. Delta is the price per identity, and zenith is the ceiling on how many fakes one operator can afford to run. Honest agents pay once and move on, while spammers' costs grow with every account they create.
